mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate indicates a growing economy, which leads to higher consumer spending and increased demand for goods and services, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 3.5% signals an easing monetary cycle, leading to increased borrowing and spending, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 60-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate below 5% indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts and a decrease in unemployment rate indicate a growing economy with increased demand for goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production indicates a growing economy with increased supply of goods and services, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate above 4% signals a tightening monetary cycle, leading to decreased borrowing and spending, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high federal funds rate (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales and an increase in unemployment rate indicate a slowing economy with decreased demand for goods and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak retail sales and high unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A high payroll employment growth rate above 200,000 indicates a strong labor market, which leads to increased consumer spending and economic growth, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth (t-test p > 0.05).
